ctx.x: Don Alias was born on December 25, 1939 in New York City. He briefly pursued a career in biochemistry but his love for percussion led him to music full time by the early 1960’s. Don has played drum set and congas with a lengthy list of jazz and popular artists, including Miles Davis, Blood, Sweat & Tears, David Sanborn and Paul Simon. He continues to tour and record and has set the highest standards for aspiring percussionists.
Don was interviewed in New York City on January 6, 2002 by Monk Rowe, director of the Hamilton College Jazz Archive.
